sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding pump housing ph-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We deeply value our twelve-year partnership and welcome your proposal for a 24-month contract. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

While we treat our detailed internal calculations as confidential, our team will provide further context regarding your request. Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us. In recognition of the extended contract term and the April 2027 effective date, we can offer a revised price of €51.80 per unit with 30-day payment terms.

To be precise, our offer stands at a price of €51.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We appreciate your revised offer and your continued commitment to our twelve-year partnership.
In response to your movement, we are prepared to lower our price to €51.10 for the 30-day payment term.
This step reflects our dedication to reaching an agreement that honors our long-standing cooperation.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

We take great pride in delivering the quality your pumps require, and we look forward to continuing our shared work.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
